A wonderful experience at Soul Ben Thanh
Sep 2026 • Friends
I just had a very fun and satisfying evening at Soul Ben Thanh. The first impression is that the restaurant space is quite luxurious, beautiful, and cozy, very suitable for dining with family, friends, or for a special evening ❤️

The dish is beautifully presented, the flavor is quite delicate, and the portion size is moderate. I especially like how the restaurant pays attention to every dish, from the presentation to the service.

The thing that impressed me the most is the service. Friendly, polite, and proactive staff to assist customers. The staff served quite quickly, always paying attention when customers needed more water, to order food, or needed assistance. The feeling of being very well taken care of throughout the meal 🥰

Space is also a big plus. The restaurant has a luxurious but not overly stiff style, suitable for taking photos and enjoying a relaxing evening in the Ben Thanh area.

✨ My favorite point:
Beautiful, luxurious space
• The dish is presented neatly
• Enthusiastic and friendly staff
Professional service
The atmosphere is very suitable for special gatherings

Thank you Jolie and the Soul Ben Thanh team for a pleasant and memorable evening! ❤️

If you don’t want to have any bad experiences while traveling, “please” skip it.
Jun 2026 • Friends
During my trip to Vietnam, I visited this restaurant after finding it online. Unfortunately, I had a very disappointing experience when trying to retrieve an umbrella I had left there.

Shortly after I left the restaurant, the hotel receptionist kindly called on my behalf. The restaurant staff confirmed that they had found my umbrella, and mentioned that it was easily identifiable because it had my hotel’s logo on it. They also assured us that they would keep it safe and that I could pick it up the next day.

Based on this confirmation, I made a special trip back to the restaurant the following day. However, when I arrived, the staff who answered the phone denied having found the umbrella. Despite my repeated requests, they maintained that it was not in their
place. I found this confusing and disappointing, especially since I had previously received confirmation that it had been found.

Two days later, while passing by the area again due to a transportation detour, I decided to return once more to ask about the umbrella. The response from the staff remained the same, and I was again told that it could not be found. At that point, I decided to look more carefully inside the restaurant area upstairs where I had originally been seated. Eventually, I discovered the umbrella was hidden behind the counter on the second floor. They can’t deny anymore.

After retrieving it, I was able to confirm that it had been kept on the premises all along. I was surprised that it had not been returned earlier despite the prior confirmation.

In addition, I found the overall food and cocktails to be not good.
Don’t waste your money and time here.

Soul Ben Thanh Restaurant & Bar
Dear FarAway22967986225 ,

First of all, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and disappointment you experienced. When we received a call from your hotel receptionist, our team confirmed that an umbrella had been left at the restaurant and did our best to assist by showing all umbrellas in our lost-and-found area, as well as contacting your hotel to compare the photo provided. Unfortunately, at that time, we did not realize that your umbrella had remained on the second floor of the restaurant.

After reviewing the incident, we found that our staff was unaware of the umbrella's location when you returned, which resulted in incorrect information being provided. This was a shortcoming in our lost-and-found inspection and management process, and we take full responsibility for the confusion and inconvenience this caused.

Although we are relieved that you were ultimately able to retrieve your umbrella, we understand that this does not make up for your disappointing experience. Please accept our sincere apologies. Should you visit Vietnam again, we would be honored to welcome you back with a complimentary meal and drinks as a gesture of our apology. We have also reviewed and improved our lost-and-found procedures to help ensure that similar situations do not happen again in the future.

Feeling Ignored and Insulted at This Restaurant
Oct 2025 • Solo
It was a total disaster as a solo traveler. Once, I went out for dinner, and a waiter approached me. I asked him if I could get a table on the second-floor terrace. He told me that it was a busy day and the upstairs area was completely full, then offered me a table on the ground floor instead. I felt so embarrassed because I was the only customer sitting there for dinner. Later, I noticed that everyone who came after me was being offered a table upstairs. I felt so insulted, but I was so hungry that I decided to stay and eat there anyway

⸻

Then he took my order — two items from the menu. After a long wait, he served me one dish along with a cappuccino without sugar. When I asked for sugar, he told me they had run out. I waited more than 40 minutes for the second dish, but then he came back and said they couldn’t serve it because it was unavailable. At that point, I immediately asked for the bill and left that unmannered restaurant.
I DON’T RECOMMEND THIS RESTAURANT FOR SOLO TRAVELERS.Because THEY NEED ONLY GROUPS

One of the worst experiences on my first trip to Vietnam. It began with the server telling me that I couldn't order a glass of Chardonnay, but I could order something else that she was promoting. So I opted for a chicken soup and a small bottle of water and a chicken soup. Both were served in a reasonable time. After that no server in sight. I finally the attention of one and I asked for the bill/check. 
This is where things got crazy. One had to go to the cashier for the bill. 
There was a foreign man in front of me who used his credit card to pay, the cashier ran it through the machine and told the man it was declined! That's a very old scam!! Happened to us in Morocco. They run your CC through their machine and say it didn't go through. So you produce another CC. This one goes through, but when you return to your country, you discover it all went through and you've been charged multiple times. I thought i was being smart by handing cash. But she said she didn't have change! RED ALERT! I then pulled our smaller currency which she shuffled with the bigger currency and triple charged me! It was very cleverly done, and as they don't speak English there's nothing you can do. IT IS A TOURIST TRAP! BE VERY CAUTIOUS! They think tourists are stupid 🙄. IM POSTING THIS TO ALERT FOREIGN PEOPLE TO BE VERY CAREFUL IN THIS PLACE. I WILL NOT BE RETURNING.

POOR MANAGEMENT DO NOT GO HERE
Feb 2024 • Couples
I don’t like how management deals with problems and mistakes. 
We ordered bbq pork and the waiter (who was training) accidentally brought the wrong order in. 
After waiting for already a long time, another person came to the table and said “can I please ask that you try the wrong order, or else the new waiter will have to pay for it”. I said “mistakes happen but I’m not paying or eating something I didn’t order” . The man said again, “ok if you don’t eat it, the new waiter will pay for it”.
For the first time, I am in utter shock by this hospitality. I also work in hospitality and I understand how easy it is to make mistakes, especially when there is a clear language barrier. However, management should apologise and find a solution instead of black mailing me into feeling bad that because of the new workers honest mistake, that then he has to pay for it. 
I really hope that they don’t actually use this method on their staff and I do not appreciate the emotional black mail. 
Will not come again and will not recommend. This is poor service (not on the new waiter) but the management or supervisor that stepped in.

reviews.review_text:
rani0511
Asker, Norway3 contributions

Terrible food and service
Jan 2023 • Friends
We ate here the first night we stayed in Saigon. We got a table outside that was dirty from the previous guests, the waiter did not clean the table for us. We were then given another table since the one we got was not for dining, just for drinks.

After we switched tables we ordered food and drinks. Two of the drinks were delivered (we were three guests). The waiter then came back and asked for our order again because he did not write it down the first time so we told him again. After about 15 minutes our appetizers came, and it was the wrong dish. We were a little confused because of the language barrier so we did not alert the waiter right away. After we looked at the menu again we saw that we got the wrong dish and alerted the waiter about 5 minutes after being served. The staff did not handle this well, and at least 3 different waiters came to our table to check if it was the wrong order and to tell us that since we had eaten one out of 7/8 spring rolls we had to pay. Even though we alerted the waiter the second we found out it was the wrong order and then stopped eating immediately.

After this the last drink finally came, about 30/40 minutes after we had ordered it. The waiter than spilled half of the drink on the table, which is fine and an accident. But the waiter did not clean the table, and than started serving the main dishes while the table were covered with beer. We had to ask multiple times before the waiter eventually cleaned the table, but it was still not done properly so we had to eat with beer spilled on the table.

The food was disappointing and looked nothing like the picture. Tasteless food in a country filled with great flavors. The food was also overpriced compared to other restaurants. 

When we asked to pay we saw that the original appetizer that we did not order was still on the bill. We asked if they could remove it since we did not order it. We then had to discuss with the staff for about 5 minutes before they eventually agreed to remove it from the bill.

All in all this was a disappointing meal, and the worst of all our restaurants visits after over one week in Vietnam. The food in Vietnam is amazing, you can get much better quality for a lower price anywhere else than this restaurant.

Dear vwbYorkshire,

Warmest Greetings from SOUL Ben Thanh Restaurant & Bar!

Thank you for sharing your thought with us here. We are happy that you enjoyed our service, but on the contrary, we are very sad that you did not enjoy our food. Perhaps, the taste of our food did not meet your standard and that is very easy to understand because not everyone has the same taste or standard or expectation for food and so we cannot satisfy everyone, but we will try harder with the hope to satisfy the hunger of our guest as much as we can. Therefore, we hope to invite you back to our restaurant one more time to see our improvement and advise us more in detail.

Moreover, we are shocked to see you stated: "Tourist trap". We really eager to know what made you said that when we have everything shown out inside our menu, or is it because of the other local guide, who took you to our restaurant? If that the case, we are sure that you have a strong misunderstand that we somehow connect with him because it was our first time meeting you and him in our Restaurant. We asked him if he has been here before and he said that he saw us several times since our location is right at the North Gate of Ben Thanh Market but it is the first time he decided to bring you to our restaurant because he took you to other place to have street food but you refuse and so he brought you to one of the Restaurant in town. We do not know what was going on between you and him but surely we were the one that took the most blow from your anger instead of him. However, we always welcome you back to our restaurant again so that we could have another chance to serve you better without the 3rd party.

reviews.review_text:
W174
Singapore, Singapore5 contributions
0
Overrated and overpriced
Feb 2020 • Couples
Most expensive meal for the smallest portions served. Charges for everything, including water. Overrated and overpriced.
Written February 7, 2020
Anh P
Dear W174,

Thank you for dining at our restaurant. It was very unfortunate to see that you have negative experience with our portion as well as how we price our services.

However, we would like to clarify few details to you. Our portions are calculated for 2 average guests just enough to enjoy. Most of our dishes are Alacarte/À la carte and so the amount of food served will not be as much as a set-menu dishes or combo. If you are strong eater, perhaps, you can ask our waiter/waitress or even our manager whether you have any set-menu or combo that can satisfy your hunger or not? We hardly received any complains about our portion except from strong eater. We know the fact that our portion can never be satisfied enough for all our guest because that is the truth that happens to all the restaurants and so we are truly sorry about that but as our surveys being done with more than 90% of our guests found that our portions are enough, therefore our portions will remain the same because if we increase our portion's size, there will probably be left over of foods and that is what we do not want.

And now to the way we price our services, we stated our price very clearly on our menu. On the other hands, since our portions are calculated to fit just enough for 2 average size guests to enjoy, so, if you do small calculation by divide the cost into two and convert it back to USD, you will see that you are actually paying less than 10 USD/pax for most of our dishes, therefore, should you still think that our price is expensive? For the water, we do not provide free water as it is nowadays a normal practice in most restaurants because we are afraid that our water source in Vietnam may not be safe enough for foreigner. Therefore, we only serve bottle of water (Lavie) or Ice Tea with boiled filtered water (will cost electricity to boil the water and run the filtered systems plus the work from our bartender to prepare the drink and clean the glass after each use). We hope that you can understand now the way we price our service and the reason why we did not provide free water.

Anyways, one star for a portion that did not satisfied your hunger even 90% of our guests find it enough, and the price which you think we overprice when the fact is that our price per person is less than 10 USD does not seem to be fair for us. Why did you not include other factors in your rating such as the quality of our food, the dining atmosphere, the view from our location, the background music etc...? We believe if you add those factors to your review, we should receive at least 3 star rating (5 star minus 2 star for portions and price). Please be fair to us!

Kind regards,
Soul Ben Thanh Team

The reason for why we said that is that during your dining experience (most of the dishes was finished empty), one of our manager approached to your family and conducted a service to ask whether the foods were OK and the portion were enough or not, and he received the feedback as quoted: "All the foods were fine and the portions were enough, except for the bowl of chicken noodle soup. I think my son did not enjoy it. He said the soup tasted like lemon. You can ask him". Knowing the problem, the manager apologized and asked your son and was confirmed that the soup tasted like lemon. However, after checking through the orders from your table, the manager found out that your son ordered one of the local specialty dish in Vietnam "Chicken Soup with Amberella's leaves", that will have the sour flavor like lemon. On the menu also stated the name of the leaves, but our manager apologized again that our staff should have informed you about the taste of that dish. Before taking his leave, he asked one last time: "beside the chicken soup with Amberella's leaves, is there anything else that does not taste good with other dishes?" and was confirmed "No, everything else is fine".

To sum up, it is very strange for us to receive another feedback rather than the chicken soup. Moreover, if the other foods were not that good "tasteless, tough and chewy", the dish will not be empty. At SOUL, we care about how our guest enjoy our dishes and that is why we conducted a little survey during and after our Guest dining experience. It is fair and square for us to receive all kind of feedback right at the time of the survey but it will be completely unfair when the feedback we received here were not exact to the one we received on spot. Therefore, we kindly ask you to amend your review and gave us the review that is true to what you have said at the restaurant. Please do not write something extra that is not correct just to escalate the matter.

Kind regards,

reviews.review_text:
Christopher F
Northampton, United Kingdom54 contributions

Great service.
Dec 2019 • Couples
We found this restaurant on TA and it was just 2 minutes walk from our hotel. The previous night we chose ( wrongly ) a none TA listed chain restaurant. ( but recommended by our hotel ) As we only had 3 nights in HCMC we didn’t want to get it wrong again!

As soon as we walked into Soul Ben Thanh we were welcomed and given our choice of table. Large plush comfortable seating. Menu was easily understood, as European’s not used to Vietnamese menus, this was important to us. Staff happy to explain and help as to how to combine the dips and sauces with the main ingredients. 

Draft tiger and an OK white wine all hit the spot. Food all as described and to everyone’s satisfaction. We felt we all had value for money and loved the attentive staff. 

Yes you could eat cheaper if you like street food, but not with this level of comfort and nice loos as well! 
Not everyone wants cheap, more important is value, and that is what we got. ( post script, we are all over 60!) and not a back-pack between us.

Great new restaurant
Sep 2019 • Solo
I'm actually still at the restaurant and the photo was taken from the table I was sitting at. It's right across from Ben Thanh market in a very lively neighborhood. The Grand Silverland hotel. Is right around the corner. The restaurant is beautiful with a fantastic balcony overlooking the intersection. There was great music playing on their sound system. The food was very high quality. I had the fresh shrimp spring rolls and the garlic-honey chicken, the chicken is in bite size pieces and cooked perfectly. The staff speaks English an the menu is also in English. The staff is dedicated to your satisfaction and very attentive, something that can be lacking in establishments with good food. In addition to the above, I had a small bowl of rice, two tiger beers and a coke light. All for 440,000vnd. Very reasonable considering the quality. They also provide cycle parking. They are new. A friend and I loved our first visit to this restaurant so much, we went back the last night we were in Saigon. It was initially recommended by our tour guide. 
The first night we ordered and ate two courses, all delicious. We loved the spring rolls, both fresh and fried. The mackerel was yummy and the vegetarian fried rice was nice without being sensational. 
Best parts of the place are: friendly staff, great music, excellent location, and reasonably priced food and drink. 
Can recommend the lemon smoothies.
The balcony on the first floor overlooks the Ben Thanh market and the associated chaos on the streets but you feel removed from it while you sit under your umbrella and drink a cold beer.
